verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a Hosted Payment Page that accepts multiple payment methods through a single integration, and a Drop-in Element that adapts its fields to the payment method and country. Its invoices and payment links cite 160+ local payment methods, and the Multi-Currency Pricing API unlocks additional local methods; redirect-flow integration guidance also exists. However, none of the evidence names Apple Pay, Google Pay or BNPL specifically. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Apple Pay/Google Pay wallet support, explicit BNPL support, explicit bank-redirect method coverage in checkout, independent or hands-on corroboration.
